title: Area changes exposure to random defects
caption: At a given defect density, a larger critical area encounters more potential defects. The yield model and defect assumptions must be stated.

nodes.label: Smaller die
nodes.detail: Exposes less critical area to random defects

nodes.label: Larger die
nodes.detail: Exposes more critical area to the same defect population

nodes.label: Wafer defect field
nodes.detail: Contains the defect distribution assumed by the model

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: Different outcomes can recover useful product
caption: Repair replaces defective elements, harvesting disables unusable resources, and binning groups remaining performance. These are distinct responses to measured behavior.

nodes.label: Repair
nodes.detail: Use spare elements to replace failing ones

nodes.label: Harvesting
nodes.detail: Disable defective circuit resources where supported

nodes.label: Binning
nodes.detail: Classify parts by measured capability

nodes.label: Useful product
nodes.detail: Ship only the functionality supported by the tested result

nodes.label: Earlier detection
nodes.detail: Recognize a harmful deviation

nodes.label: Containment

nodes.label: Yield learning
